li.label: pity for construct
li.description: Grown in a vat and engineered to serve without complaint, only to die in the dirt. To live such a hollow life and perish... it just isn't right.

li.label: synaptic echo
li.description: My head aches with a hollow, buzzing static. Thoughts feel sluggish and distant, like someone reached into my skull, photocopied my memories, and put them back slightly out of order.
